thread:
morgan: Spinning up this thread to track the postmortem action items + owners. Want clear owners, hard deadlines, and a weekly status ping until closed. Please reply with accept/blocker/date.

ashley: I can take token validation test coverage and the synthetic monitor. Will add unit + integration tests and a nightly synthetic that hits token endpoints. Blocker: need a test service account. ETA: 2026-04-12.

kevin: Taking audit pipeline fixes. Plan: add strict schema validation at ingestion, emit a metric for dropped events, and alert on >0.1% drop over 5m. Will open AUTHZ-1492 with PR. ETA: 2026-04-06.

priya: Own rotation automation + emergency rotation playbook. Proposal: implement a k8s CronJob that triggers Vault rotate API with safe-guards, plus a one-click rollback script. Need time to coordinate with infra. ETA: 2026-04-25.

izzy: I'll own permissions drift detection rules (IAM policies vs expected), and add a nightly audit job. ETA: 2026-04-15.

morgan: Good. Let's make each of these a card on the remediation board and tag severity/regression risk. I'll create epics today. Also proposing a 30m weekly stand on Wednesdays 9am PT until all items are closed.

ashley: Quick note on the synthetic: it should exercise token issuance, refresh, and failure modes (malformed token, expired token). I'll put a checklist in the ticket.

kevin: For schema validation here's a sketch of the check we can run before committing to DS:```python
required = ["user_id","actor","token_id","action","ts","origin"]
def is_valid(evt):
    return all(k in evt and evt[k] is not None for k in required)
```
Will attach test vectors.

priya: Emergency rotation playbook draft snippet (WIP):
1) put service into maintenance
2) run rotate-secrets --env prod --dry-run
3) promote rotated secrets to staging
4) smoke test for 15m
5) promote to prod or rollback
Will post full draft by Friday.

ops-bot: Reminder: weekly follow-up scheduled by morgan.

morgan: For tracking: owners and rough dates recap: ashley (token tests + synthetic) 2026-04-12; kevin (audit schema + alerts) 2026-04-06; izzy (permissions drift) 2026-04-15; priya (rotation automation + playbook) 2026-04-25. If any of you need more time, call it out now so I can adjust the cadence.

ashley: ack. I'll post the synthetic job yaml and test account request by EOD.

kevin: ack. I'll link AUTHZ-1492 and the PR before the Wednesday sync.

izzy: ack. I'll add the policy-drift detector prototype to the infra repo and post results to the ticket.

priya: ack. coordinating with infra for access, will post playbook draft by Friday.

morgan: Thanks team. I'll create the epics and calendar invite. Also adding a short section in the runbook on "How to tell if this is recurring" with concrete signals: sudden spike in token-parse errors, gap in audit events for a service, unexpected TTL resets.

izzy: Suggestion: create a small alert runbook mapping signal -> first responder -> mitigation steps. I'll help author that.

morgan: Perfect. Closing notes: weekly status pinned to the ticket, owners to post progress 24h before sync. See you on Wednesday. :white_check_mark:
